title: Data Scientist
description:
Your New Company
Our client is delivering a secure, enterprise-scale AI and analytics platform within a regulated public sector environment. The programme aims to enable scalable and production-ready AI and machine learning capabilities through modern cloud technologies and engineering best practices.

Your New Role
As a Data Engineer, you will design and develop integrations, event-driven ingestion pipelines, and data migration solutions to support a large-scale AI platform. Working within a cloud-native AWS environment, you will build reliable data movement processes, implement reconciliation mechanisms, and ensure data quality, scalability, and security throughout the platform.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Strong experience building integrations using APIs, webhooks, REST services, and event streams.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services including API Gateway, Lambda, EventBridge, SQS, and DynamoDB.
  • Strong Python development skills for automation and data engineering.
  • Experience implementing reconciliation processes and state tracking.
  • Practical experience delivering data migration projects using AWS DMS or similar technologies.
  • Experience with Apache Airflow, dbt, Jira, or Confluence would be beneficial.


What You'll Get in Return

  • Opportunity to contribute to an innovative enterprise AI programme.
  • Exposure to modern cloud, data engineering, and AI technologies.
  • Flexible hybrid working environment.
  • Collaborative team focused on delivering secure and scalable solutions within a high-profile programme

What you need to do now
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.
